description: The expedition confronts Michael's growing threat and discovers the Asurans, while Ronon's past, McKay's family and the surviving Ancients force Atlantis to reconsider who owns the city and what its technology can do.

s03e01.description: Sheppard is stranded aboard a Wraith hive after the failed alliance, forcing enemies to cooperate while Atlantis tries to prevent the Wraith from reaching Earth.

s03e02.description: Atlantis attempts to turn captured Wraith into humans with Beckett's retrovirus while Michael's survival makes the experiment increasingly unstable.

s03e03.description: The team meets Lucius Lavin, a seemingly irresistible man whose entire village adores him for reasons that become chemically suspicious.

s03e04.description: The Wraith return Ronon to his devastated homeworld and begin hunting him again, turning Sateda into a deadly arena for old memories and unfinished revenge.

s03e05.description: Atlantis discovers a technologically advanced civilization of human-form Replicators created by the Ancients and still obsessed with their makers.

s03e06.description: Weir awakens in a psychiatric hospital on Earth where everyone insists Atlantis was a delusion, while a nanite infection attacks her real body.

s03e07.description: Kolya captures Sheppard and forces a captive Wraith to feed on him repeatedly, creating an unexpected bond between two prisoners.

s03e08.description: McKay's estranged sister Jeannie is brought to Atlantis when her mathematical work offers a way to draw power from another universe.

s03e09.description: A Wraith device makes Sheppard's team hallucinate enemies and turn on one another while searching for a missing expedition unit.

s03e10.description: A surviving Ancient crew returns and reclaims Atlantis, sending the expedition back to Earth just as the Asurans begin moving against the city.

s03e11.description: Sheppard's team defies orders and returns to Pegasus when the Asurans attack the Ancients now occupying Atlantis.

s03e12.description: Whale-like creatures gather around Atlantis as visions of the city's Ancient past warn of an approaching stellar catastrophe.

s03e13.description: Lucius has reinvented himself as a celebrated hero using an Ancient personal shield, until real danger exposes the fraud behind his reputation.

s03e14.description: An Ancient device accelerates McKay's evolution and gives him extraordinary abilities, but the transformation will kill him unless he can ascend.

s03e15.description: Sheppard and McKay discover that civilizations they have been treating as pieces in an Ancient strategy game are real and now on the brink of war.

s03e16.description: A damaged station holds thousands of people as stored consciousnesses awaiting new bodies, leaving the team with an impossible rescue before the structure fails.

s03e17.description: A rare day off in Atlantis is shattered by an unexploded device, forcing the expedition to confront sudden loss inside what had begun as ordinary life.

s03e18.description: Exploration beneath Atlantis awakens a trapped Wraith queen who has survived for millennia by feeding on her own crew.

s03e19.description: The team investigates an abandoned settlement and discovers Michael has been creating human-Wraith hybrids for a private army.

s03e20.description: After Apollo attacks the Asuran homeworld, the Replicators retaliate with a weapon that forces Atlantis to leave its ocean and attempt interstellar flight.
